description: This PHP class defines a filter parameter data transfer object (DTO) for employee membership search within a Human Resource Management system. It extends a base FilterParams class and includes a property for employee number, along with getter and setter methods. It also defines allowed sorting fields.

classes.name: EmployeeMembershipSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for encapsulating search filter parameters related to employee memberships, providing sorting options and an employee number filter.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter params with default sort field.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number filter value, if set.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Assigns a value to the employee number filter parameter.

search-terms: PHP class for HRM employee membership filter
